scenes.conflict: The figures show the debt is deeper than her relatives admit, and they are quietly planning to buy Bell Warden loyalty by illicit means.
scenes.goal: Isolde audits House Veyra's books to learn how long the house can survive the Lamp Guild's debt.
scenes.outcome: Isolde resolves to restructure the debt before the Guild cuts the light, and she finds an entry hinting that the Terrace Charter rests on something false.
scenes.summary: In the whispering balconies, Isolde alone reads the true depth of the house's ruin and sees that her family's solution may doom them faster.
scenes.title: The Ledger of Oaths

scenes.conflict: Isolde tries to bargain for time without conceding the oaths, while Marcus courteously prices every concession and refuses to believe she acts from anything but profit.
scenes.goal: Marcus Dray wants Isolde to surrender House Veyra's oaths in return for more hours of light.
scenes.outcome: Marcus gives her a deadline before the Terraces go dark, and Isolde leaves knowing she needs leverage against him.
scenes.summary: In the lamplit market, Marcus lays out the Guild's terms with soft menace and sets the clock on the Terraces.
scenes.title: Hours of Light

scenes.conflict: Isolde distrusts brokers, and Seraphine, whose debts Marcus is buying, hints at a Silent Bell secret without revealing it.
scenes.goal: Seraphine wants to sell Isolde information that will keep the Veyra account open to her.
scenes.outcome: Isolde pays for a hint that the Wardens hold proof about the Silent Bell, and she resolves to reach someone inside the crypt.
scenes.summary: Seraphine trades a tantalizing rumor for coin, pointing Isolde toward the Bell Crypt.
scenes.title: A Broker's Whisper

scenes.conflict: Senior Wardens watch him closely, and his vow of silence prevents him from asking anyone for help.
scenes.goal: Oren searches the crypt records for proof of who silenced the bell.
scenes.outcome: Oren finds a record that has been altered and hears a faint answer from the stone, convincing him the order concealed the truth.
scenes.summary: Alone with the bells, Oren finds the first hard sign of a cover-up and keeps it to himself.
scenes.title: Beneath the Altar

scenes.conflict: Oren, secretive and paralyzed by his vow, refuses to speak, and the Wardens guard the crypt.
scenes.goal: Isolde wants access to the crypt records to find proof about the Silent Bell.
scenes.outcome: Isolde reads Oren's guarded manner and, using her ledger skills, spots the forged entry he found, and Oren reluctantly acknowledges it.
scenes.summary: Isolde's forensic eye and Oren's silence collide over a doctored record in the dark.
scenes.title: A Guarded Visit

scenes.conflict: Seraphine wants independence but depends on the debts Marcus now holds.
scenes.goal: Marcus wants Seraphine to become a Guild informant against House Veyra and the Wardens.
scenes.outcome: Seraphine agrees to feed him information while privately planning to keep the Silent Bell secret to sell to the highest bidder.
scenes.summary: Marcus tightens his hold by pressing Seraphine's debts and extracting a reluctant promise.
scenes.title: Loyalists for the Bells

scenes.conflict: The relatives' scheme would break the oaths and invite casting out, and Seraphine's information could be sold to the Guild as readily as to Isolde.
scenes.goal: Isolde wants to stop her relatives from bribing Bell Wardens, and Seraphine wants to sell the news of it.
scenes.outcome: Isolde halts the bribe by exposing its flaws in the ledger, but Seraphine learns how much the secret is worth to her.
scenes.summary: Isolde confronts her kin over the bribe while Seraphine watches the leverage grow.
scenes.title: The Illicit Bargain

scenes.conflict: His loyalty to the Wardens clashes with his belief they hid the truth, and his habitual secrecy resists.
scenes.goal: Oren decides whether to share what he found with Isolde.
scenes.outcome: Oren shows Isolde the altered records pointing to a cover-up, and the stone answers him, though he cannot prove it to her.
scenes.summary: Oren breaks his vow and gives Isolde the evidence, forging an alliance.
scenes.title: Breaking Silence

scenes.conflict: Oren refuses to be bought, and lies spoken in the crypt cause the bells to ring out of turn, threatening the city's air.
scenes.goal: Seraphine tries to pry the crypt secrets from Oren.
scenes.outcome: Seraphine's bargaining nearly gets Oren and the district into danger, and the Wardens notice her interest in the crypt.
scenes.summary: A lie in the crypt sets the bells ringing wrongly, and the Wardens close in.
scenes.title: Out of Turn

scenes.conflict: The Terraces dim while Isolde has only partial proof and cannot expose the Charter without destroying her house.
scenes.goal: Marcus enforces his deadline and Isolde tries to hold the house together.
scenes.outcome: Isolde decides to confront the Wardens and the Guild together with the truth about the Silent Bell.
scenes.summary: The light fails on the Terraces and Isolde commits to a high-risk reckoning.
scenes.title: The Terraces Go Dark

scenes.conflict: Isolde arrives to stop the sale, and Marcus, who will not believe in motives other than profit, bids to own the secret.
scenes.goal: Seraphine tries to sell the Silent Bell truth to Marcus.
scenes.outcome: The bidding nearly gets Isolde seized, and Seraphine gives up the profitable secret to protect her.
scenes.summary: The market becomes an auction for the truth until Seraphine chooses Isolde over the price.
scenes.title: The Highest Bidder

scenes.conflict: Marcus tries to seize the bells, Oren must defy the Wardens, and the stone answers as the truth threatens House Veyra's own Charter.
scenes.goal: Isolde exposes the truth of the Silent Bell and forces a new settlement of oaths and debts.
scenes.outcome: The evidence shows light and air cannot be owned, Marcus faces ruin or sharing power, and the Charter's flaw is made public.
scenes.summary: In the dark beneath the altar, all parties confront the buried truth and the bells ring in the right order.
scenes.title: The Reckoning of the Bells

scenes.conflict: Marcus must choose between ruin and shared power, and Isolde's relatives resent the exposure of the Charter.
scenes.goal: Isolde and Marcus negotiate a new settlement of oaths and debts.
scenes.outcome: Marcus accepts a shared arrangement for light and debts, and House Veyra's debt is restructured at a cost to its pride.
scenes.summary: With the truth public, the Terrace Charter is rewritten and the light returns.
scenes.title: Oaths Rewritten

scenes.conflict: The Wardens answer to no court, and Oren has broken their secrecy while Seraphine has lost her profitable secret.
scenes.goal: Oren settles his place among the Wardens, and Seraphine and Isolde part ways or ally.
scenes.outcome: Oren remains a Warden who keeps the records open, Seraphine goes on in modest independence, and the stone's whispers remain unexplained.
scenes.summary: In the quiet crypt, the survivors reckon with what they gave up and what the cathedral still listens to.
scenes.title: What the Stone Keeps

logline: As the Lamp Guild squeezes House Veyra with debt and both powers scheme to seat their own people among the Bell Wardens, ledger-keeper Isolde Veyra must uncover the truth of the Night of the Silent Bell before the light is cut and her family is cast out into the trench.
theme: Light and air cannot be owned without a reckoning for the lies beneath.
title: Abyssal Courts
